pkgmetadata.longdescription: UUWay runs the official NetEase UU Remote Windows host under Wine and replaces the Windows interfaces it relies on with native Linux ones: Wayland screen capture through the PipeWire portal, NVENC or VA-API encoding, uinput keyboard and mouse injection, Fcitx5 text input, clipboard and file transfer, and a local login shell as the remote terminal. This package installs the upstream Ubuntu build, so it needs a GNOME Wayland or Hyprland session with systemd user services.
